concept: S3 Lifecycle: transition and expiration without code
tests: How to move objects to a cheaper class after 90 days and delete them after a year with minimal operational work.
expected: S3 Lifecycle policy: transition rule (90 days → IA/Glacier) + expiration rule (365 days). Triggers: "move to cheaper tier", "deleted after one year", "least operational".
why_not: Custom Lambda, EC2 cron and manual deletion — extra code, overhead and risk of errors.
